scenarios.fact: Exact channels, messages, and personas exist in the fresh target or arm-isolated namespace.
Members join allowed channels and Mallory cannot read or subscribe privately.
A sent message has server-authoritative identity, author, and order.
Bob observes Alice's committed message through native push.
Cursor pages are stable and nonduplicating under a concurrent insert.
Typing is ephemeral through a native path or recorded as GAP/application glue.
Presence reflects connect, disconnect, and expiry through a native path or explicit GAP.
Reconnect restores authoritative channel view without duplicate messages.
Previously loaded history is readable offline where supported, otherwise GAP.
Unread state remains correct across two clients and a reconnect.
Concurrent sends preserve both messages with deterministic order.
Membership removal stops future delivery and handles retained history honestly.
Frozen burst, read, realtime, reconnect, and build/deploy samples are retained.
Only exact fresh targets or the arm-owned shared-target namespace are cleaned up; unrelated baseline state is preserved.
